sections.Why You'll Love It:

Smooths the skin surface and improves its appearance with rich hydration
Leaves the skin feeling plump, refreshed, and visibly revitalized

Apply after cleansing and toning
Place the top mask on the forehead and cheek area

For Sensitive Skin: Perform a patch test on a small area of your inner arm before using this product on your entire face.

Apply Sheet: Tear open an individual pouch, gently unfold the mask sheet, and place it squarely over the face, aligning the integrated eye, nose, and mouth cutouts perfectly. Press softly to ensure high-adherence contact across the entire skin surface.
Chill: Allow the sheet mask to sit comfortably for 15 to 20 minutes while it continuously diffuses its active thermal cooling essence into the skin barrier.
Pat to Finish: Gently peel away the mask sheet and discard. Do not rinse with water. Lightly tap the remaining active fluid essence into your face and neck lines using your fingertips until fully absorbed. Follow up with your favorite daily lotion or cream to permanently seal in the fresh hydration.

Extra Cooling: For an amplified cryogenic experience when dealing with extreme sunburn or post-procedural heat, store the un-opened sheet pouches inside your beauty refrigerator 15 minutes prior to application.
Neck Application: Smooth any excess fluid essence remaining inside the pouch over your collarbones, neck lines, and hands to extend the calming benefits across your full upper torso.

Caution & Attention
For external cosmetic use only. Conducting a small spot-patch test prior to initial use on raw or freshly peeled skin is recommended.
Discontinue use immediately if persistent swelling, burning, unusual rash, or severe topical discomfort occurs.
Do not apply directly onto open weeping wounds or actively bleeding lesions.
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight exposure and high ambient temperatures to preserve the structural stability of the active soothing complex.
